propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml is redundant because it performs identical test setup to _build-and-test.yml and runs tests already covered by the full matrix with strictly greater coverage.
Deleting import-linter frees a concurrent job slot against a GitHub Free org cap of 20 slots, where a single Gerrit Verified run requires 21.
Removing import-linter without a replacement guard risks future edits (marker additions, file moves, path filters) silently deleting optionality test coverage with a passing build.
The existing parity checks (test_ci_workflow_parity.py and check_verify_gate_parity.py) have no visibility into _optionality.yml inner job structure and cannot detect the job deletion.
A durable checked-in test asserting collection of 9 items from the two target files under default pytest selection (-m 'not integration and not external') prevents accidental coverage loss.
